components.description: Project schedule: one row per task, bar = start → end on a week scale, colour = team (categorical); diamond = milestone, dashed dataviz/target line = today. Progress shows the planned bar at layer opacity 0.28 with the done part solid and % outside the bar (no text on colour). 3–20 tasks; group by phase or team. Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Sort by start date or group by phase/team.
One colour per team, explained in the legend.
Progress % outside the bar (no text on colour).
Show today; without it a schedule cannot be read.
Timeline vs. Gantt
Use Diagram/Timeline item for a sequence of events; Gantt when durations and overlaps matter.
